simulatedDay.summary: Drafted optimized Etsy listings for 3 new lavender and eucalyptus candle variants — titles, tags, and descriptions ready for review
Logged 5 batches of hand-poured candles completed today: 24 lavender, 18 vanilla, 12 seasonal blends — updated finished-goods inventory
Created invoices and receipts for 7 orders shipped this week — all reconciled with Etsy payout records
Processed 4 customer messages: 2 shipment status questions (replied with tracking), 1 scent recommendation request (drafted response), 1 custom order inquiry flagged for escalation
Reviewed this week's Etsy shop stats: 156 shop views, 12 favorites, 2 sales — identified seasonal lavender listing as top performer

charterDraft.sharpenedIdea: Handmade scented candles sold directly through Etsy, starting with core scents (lavender, vanilla, seasonal blends) and expanding based on customer feedback and trend data.
charterDraft.mvpDefinition: An Etsy shop launching with 5–8 core candle SKUs (different scents and styles), professional product photography, optimized listings, a basic inventory system, and order-to-ship fulfillment workflows. The focus is on getting real customer feedback and proving demand before scaling production or adding complex product lines.

tasks: Draft a weekly priority list highlighting the top 3–5 tasks across all teams
Flag any conflicts or bottlenecks (e.g., production delays affecting fulfillment, or marketing campaigns blocked by stock levels)
Prepare a brief weekly check-in summary for the founder
Oversee all financial operations: invoicing, expense tracking, cash-flow forecasting, and tax compliance
Monitor Etsy payouts and reconcile with order records
Track all business expenses (raw materials, packaging, Etsy fees, shipping supplies) and categorize for tax purposes
Maintain a 30/60/90-day cash-flow forecast to ensure the business stays within budget and alert the founder if burn rate is unsustainable
Flag and track all Texas sales-tax collection and remittance obligations for Etsy sales, and track quarterly due dates
Prepare quarterly tax documents and checklists for professional review
Grow awareness and sales for the Etsy shop through targeted marketing across Instagram, Pinterest, and TikTok
Research trending candle scents, seasonal themes, and design styles to keep product ideas fresh and customer-focused
Monitor Etsy shop analytics (views, favorites, conversion rates) and use insights to optimize listings and marketing spend
Draft and continuously improve Etsy product listing copy, titles, and tags for search visibility
Write occasional blog or newsletter content in the shop's brand voice to build community
Manage email marketing sequences for new customers and repeat-purchase campaigns
Create platform-sized social media posts that showcase products, behind-the-scenes candle-making, and customer testimonials
Manage end-to-end inventory: track stock levels for each product SKU and flag reorder points for raw materials (wax, fragrance, wicks) and packaging
Coordinate with vendors to place reorder communications and ensure supplies arrive on time
Oversee the production process: track batch runs (wax, fragrance, and wick quantities used per batch), log completed candles, and update finished-goods inventory after each production session
Fulfill orders: post shipping updates and tracking information to customers within 24 hours of dispatch
Identify and resolve any production or supply-chain bottlenecks that could delay fulfillment
Receive and triage all inbound customer messages: read, tag by urgency and topic (e.g., shipment status, scent question, bulk order), and draft responses to frequently asked questions
Identify angry, confused, or complex cases and escalate to the founder with full context and recommended next steps
Maintain a knowledge base of common customer questions and responses to speed up future triage
Track customer sentiment and flag any systemic issues (e.g., shipping delays, product concerns) to the founder

monthOneGoals: Launch the Etsy shop with 5–8 core candle SKUs, professional product photos, and optimized listings ready for traffic
Establish repeatable production and fulfillment workflows: complete at least 3 full batch production runs and fulfill 20+ test orders with 100% on-time delivery
Build initial audience: post 2–3 times per week on Instagram and Pinterest, and reach 100 initial followers across social channels
Validate product-market fit: collect at least 10 customer reviews and identify the top-selling scent(s) to inform next month's focus
Set up financial infrastructure: open a dedicated business bank account, establish expense tracking, and run a first cash-flow forecast
